description.value: Andonis is a Mediterranean and Greek supper club on Granville Street in downtown Vancouver, blending elevated cuisine with live music, DJ sets, and curated entertainment into one immersive experience. Self-described as Vancouver's first true supper club, it draws on Greek coastal culinary traditions with a contemporary twist and a private dining room (Cretes Room) that seats up to 14 guests. For touring cyclists, it represents an upscale dinner destination in the heart of Vancouver's entertainment corridor.
